evidentiary_note: The dual-lane architecture was selected during the 2022-2024 development phase after authority research and a formation feasibility check. Formation reproduction is development evidence, not untouched validation. The architecture and all thresholds are locked here before any 2025 challenge evaluation.
upper_problem: online condition/health monitoring with degradation progression, alarm escalation, structural failure/break confirmation, recovery from aborted warnings, and post-break regime stabilization

authority_basis.reference: Kothamasu, Huang and VerDuin (2006), System health monitoring and prognostics — a review of current paradigms and practices
authority_basis.use: condition monitoring may use current system-state measurements directly and augment them with prognosis; this supports a structural-health lane distinct from independent predictive evidence

authority_basis.reference: Putter, Fiocco and Geskus (2007), Tutorial in biostatistics: competing risks and multi-state models
authority_basis.use: intermediate states and transition-specific interpretation rather than a single binary endpoint

authority_basis.reference: Jackson (2011), Multi-State Models for Panel Data: The msm Package for R
authority_basis.use: multi-state transition structure with time-varying state evidence

authority_basis.reference: NIST (2025), Comprehensive evaluations of condition monitoring-based technologies in industrial maintenance: A systematic review
authority_basis.use: condition-monitoring evaluation should separate monitoring performance, validation design and operational false-alarm burden

authority_basis.reference: Xie, Zou, Xie and Veeravalli (2021), Sequential (Quickest) Change Detection: Classical Results and New Directions
authority_basis.use: online monitoring must balance detection delay and false alarms; motivates event/episode metrics rather than standalone direction accuracy

STRUCTURAL_HEALTH_LANE.signal: PATH_HALF = adverse_fraction >= 0.50 under the already frozen WP3 anatomy baseline
STRUCTURAL_HEALTH_LANE.interpretation: causal current health/degradation proximity to the frozen structural-break boundary; not independent predictive evidence

TACTICAL_EVIDENCE_LANE.signal: FAST conflict/opposite under the frozen FAST identity

CONFIRMATION_LANE.signal: SLOW robust support of the new regime under its completed-week clock

transition_rules.global_priority: frozen current-origin k=3.0 break condition -> CONFIRMED_BREAK immediately, flip regime, preserve whether a pre-break warning existed
transition_rules.WEAKENING_TO_STABLE: neither PATH_HALF nor FAST_CONFLICT remains active
transition_rules.BREAK_ALERT_TO_WEAKENING: strong alert condition clears but PATH_HALF or FAST_CONFLICT remains
transition_rules.CONFIRMED_BREAK_TO_NEW_REGIME: SLOW robustly supports the new current regime
transition_rules.NEW_REGIME_TO_STABLE: FAST and SLOW both robustly support the new current regime

excluded_primary_inputs.CUSUM: WP4B authority-default h=5 and h=4 sensitivity had no incremental state-transition value; no threshold lowering is permitted
excluded_primary_inputs.EMERGENCY_REVERSAL: WP3 same-origin review found no incremental early-warning recall gain over FAST and higher false-warning burden
excluded_primary_inputs.BOCPD: slow regime context only; not promoted to daily trigger
excluded_primary_inputs.MONTHLY_H1_MONTHLY_DIRECTION: strategic independent monthly context, not short-term trigger
excluded_primary_inputs.GVZ_MACRO_MARKET_SHOCK_OPTIONAL_EXPERTS: deferred until an accepted core exists

dual_lane_feasibility_check.reason_for_lock: same recall as FAST_CONFLICT with materially earlier warning while staying below the already frozen PATH_HALF burden ceiling; requires locked 2025 challenge before any promotion

challenge_gate.required_data: canonical exact NY17 semantics plus PIT-safe FAST/SLOW; historical hourly 17:00 ET replay is not an acceptable substitute for exact 16:59 one-minute canonical XAU unless equivalence is separately proven
challenge_gate.primary_comparator: FAST_CONFLICT on the same challenge origins and frozen break inventory
challenge_gate.accept_monitoring_signal_if: dual-lane prebreak recall >= FAST_CONFLICT, dual-lane median lead observations > FAST_CONFLICT, and dual-lane false warning episodes per 100 origins <= 5.698005698005698
